name: Pomáz (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of green triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Pomáz: a white oval with a green tree within a yellow baroque frame inscribed POMÁZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pomáz arms in a yellow frame
